title: WatchDogsGo 0.9.19 - ADS-B and mesh map fixes
notes:
RELEASE 0.9.19 - ADS-B AND MESH MAP FIXES
--------------------------------------
1. ADS-B MAP AND RADAR
---------------------
Before: aircraft stayed on screen after ADS-B was switched OFF.
Changed: ADS-B OFF now hides aircraft on the map and small radar.
With ADS-B ON, positions older than 60 seconds are hidden in both views.
Callsign or speed messages no longer make an old position look fresh.
A confirmed STOP clears only the live aircraft cache. If STOP cannot
finish, the game reports pending shutdown instead of claiming success.
Saved XP, logs, counters and session XP deduplication remain intact.

2. MESHCORE AND MESHTASTIC MAP AFTER RESTART
------------------------------------------
Before: startup could draw the entire saved contact archive as map
markers, even before receiving a node in the new session. GPS backfill
could also bring historical markers back without a new reception.
Changed: each game session starts with an empty mesh map. A node gets
a marker after reception in that session. GPS assignment alone does
not put saved contacts back on the map. Both protocols follow this rule.
As in LOCOSP 0.9.16, markers received this session stay until the game
closes, including after LoRa OFF. Saved contacts, notes, XP, badges and
logs are retained; clearing the map does not delete the contact list.

3. ONE INSTALLATION FOR ALL MISSING FIXES
---------------------------------------
Before: the update window always displayed the full published text.
Changed: install the complete latest version with one confirmation.
0.9.17 goes directly to 0.9.19, including the earlier 0.9.18 fixes.
0.9.18 receives the remaining 0.9.19 code changes. A separate intermediate
installation is not needed. Restart the game after installation.
The 0.9.19 reader can filter versioned descriptions in future updates.
During this first transition, old 0.9.17/0.9.18 readers show both sections;
the section below is clearly marked for people upgrading from 0.9.17.

RELEASE 0.9.18 - PREVIOUS FIXES
-----------------------------
Catch-up for users upgrading from 0.9.17. Already on 0.9.18? These fixes
are already installed; the new changes are in the 0.9.19 section above.

WatchDogsGo 0.9.18
Original game by LOCOSP. Modified by KiloGramowy.

1. XP, LEVEL AND SAVED DATA
---------------------------
Before: an old v1 save could lose XP, badges, contacts and history.
Changed: preserve saved progress and counters; create a backup before
migration. Saved zero stays zero. Unsafe migration stops startup.
For a separate clone, run.sh accepts the old installation root as its
data argument. Already erased XP requires an intact save or backup.

2. BLE SCAN COMPLETION
----------------------
Before: Linux bridge results could end with a false scan timeout.
Changed: accept its final BLE scan done marker. Keep XIAO/projectZero
Summary support and save/STOP checks. Adapter warnings pause scanning;
late replies cannot restart a cancelled schedule.
Validation: bridge completion handling passes software tests. AC1200
hardware testing is pending; our own setup uses XIAO ESP32-C5.
The fix is expected to address this completion-marker mismatch when
the Linux adapters, drivers and bridge are already working.

3. MESHCORE CONTACT LIST
------------------------
Before: Ctrl+H hid an empty list; keys still reached the chat.
Changed: show CONTACTS (0), block chat input while the panel is open,
and close the empty panel with Esc without leaving chat. Keep the panel
visible after deleting the final contact.

4. MESHTASTIC CONTACT LIST
--------------------------
Before: Ctrl+H hid the panel when no contacts were saved.
Changed: show CONTACTS (0) and the empty-list message. Keep MeshCore and
Meshtastic contacts and panel states separate.

5. UPDATE NOTES
---------------
Before: change descriptions used one text color.
Changed: use numbered yellow titles on dark strips, underlines and blank
line; keep the factual description in white.
